## ⚠️ OUTDATED / DEPRECATED NOTIFICATION

> ### 🛑 ATTENTION: VulkanFX is no longer actively maintained for newer Minecraft versions.
> 
> 
> With the release of Minecraft **26.2**, the official Vulkan API backend has been natively integrated into major performance stacks. Therefore, this project has been merged into our main flagship pack:
> 👉 **[Click Here to Download Renderium Optimized (26.2)](https://modrinth.com/modpack/renderium-optimized)**
> #### Why switch to Renderium Optimized?
> 
> 
> * **Full Compatibility:** Supports Minecraft 26.2 and the latest Fabric ecosystem perfectly.
> * **Native Vulkan:** Uses the stable, built-in *"Prefer Vulkan"* rendering engine directly integrated into Sodium (no separate VulkanMod crashes).
> * **Up-to-Date Features:** Features modern Quality of Life mods, EMF/ETF animations, and massive stability improvements without experimental desync issues.
> 
> 
> *If you still wish to use this legacy pack for older versions, the original description remains below:*

---

# VulkanFX Optimized 🚀

**Ultra-lightweight Fabric performance modpack with Vulkan renderer for maximum FPS and minimal RAM usage.**

> ⚠️ **IMPORTANT:** This modpack requires a **Vulkan-compatible GPU** to work properly. 
> 
> **Supported:** NVIDIA GTX 900+ / RTX series, AMD RX 400+ / RX 5000+, Intel Arc
> 
> **Not Supported:** Intel HD Graphics 4000-6000, very old GPUs
> 
> If you're unsure, check if your GPU supports Vulkan at [vulkan.gpuinfo.org](https://vulkan.gpuinfo.org/)

---

| Metric | Value |

## 🎯 Why Choose VulkanFX?

✅ **Extreme Performance** - 750+ FPS on modern hardware  
✅ **Low RAM Usage** - Only 740MB RAM consumption  
✅ **Vulkan Renderer** - Superior performance over OpenGL  
✅ **Optimized for All Systems** - Works on low-end and high-end PCs 
✅ **Stable & Reliable** - 20 TPS, minimal lag spikes  
✅ **44 Carefully Selected Mods** - No bloat, only performance  

---

## 🔧 Key Optimization Mods

### Rendering
- **VulkanMod** - Vulkan API renderer (replaces OpenGL)
- **Borderless Windowed Vulkan** - Borderless window mode
- **Not Enough Vulkan** - Additional Vulkan optimizations

### Chunk Management
- **C2ME** - Concurrent Chunk Management Engine
- **Lithium** - Game logic optimization
- **ModernFix** - Startup & runtime optimization

### Memory
- **FerriteCore** - Memory usage reduction
- **MemoryTune** - Lightweight memory optimization
- **ImmediatelyFast** - Fast entity & GUI rendering

### Performance
- **EntityCulling** - Don't render hidden entities
- **Noxesium** - Advanced performance optimizations
- **Dynamic FPS** - Adjust FPS when window is inactive
- **Krypton** - Network stack optimizations

---

## 📋 System Requirements

### Minimum
- **CPU:** Dual-core processor
- **RAM:** 2GB allocated to Minecraft
- **GPU:** Vulkan-compatible GPU (NVIDIA/AMD/Intel)
- **OS:** Windows 10/11, Linux, macOS

### Recommended
- **CPU:** Quad-core processor (i5/Ryzen 5 or better)
- **RAM:** 4GB allocated to Minecraft
- **GPU:** RTX 3050 / GTX 1650 or better
- **OS:** Linux (CachyOS/Arch) or Windows 11

### Tested On
- **GPU:** NVIDIA RTX 4050 Mobile
- **CPU:** Intel i5-13420H
- **OS:** CachyOS Linux
- **Result:** 750+ FPS, 740MB RAM

---

## 📦 Installation

1. Install **Prism Launcher** or **Modrinth App**
2. Create new instance with **Minecraft 26.1.2**
3. Select **Fabric** loader (0.19.3)
4. Download this modpack
5. Launch and enjoy!

---

## 🎮 Configuration

### Recommended Settings
- **Render Distance:** 12-16 chunks
- **Max FPS:** Unlimited or 165 (VSync recommended)
- **Graphics:** Fast
- **Clouds:** Off/Fast

---

## 🐛 Known Issues

- Integrated server (singleplayer) may have 18-19 TPS (normal)
- MSPT spikes to 150-200ms occasionally (rare)
- Requires Vulkan-compatible GPU !!

---

## 📊 Performance Tips

1. **Close background applications** (Steam, Firefox, etc.)
2. **Use performance mode** on your laptop/PC
3. **Set vm.swappiness=10** (Linux users)
4. **Allocate 2-4GB RAM** (not more!)
5. **Use 165 FPS limit + VSync** for stable experience
